DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Hodgkin Lymphoma)

The normal LDH reading makes a highly aggressive lymphoma less likely, but the combination of significant lymphocytosis, chronic fatigue, weight loss, and persistent cervical/axillary lymphadenopathy is still highly suspicious for a lymphoproliferative disorder. Given your age and these specific findings, I recommend proceeding with a biopsy of one of the enlarged nodes to confirm the diagnosis.
